fusions.name: Snarl Lash
fusions.desc: A lashing strike that deals 7 damage, leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds and has a 40% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Thousand Threads
fusions.desc: Looses 4 strands in a fan, each dealing 4 damage, with a 25% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds. Your afflictions on a target hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Woven Ward
fusions.desc: Weaves a barrier that absorbs the next 18 damage, up to 6 blows, and holds for 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 8% while it holds.

fusions.name: Strand Ledger
fusions.desc: Every hit you land ties a strand to that enemy, up to 6. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: the strands pull tight and strike it for 27% of your weapon damage per strand (163% at full). Unfed, a strand fades every 4 seconds.
